message.mod_e539c988.driving_hint: Current: %1$s; launch mode ON by default; W/S throttle, A/D steering, V toggles mode, Shift dismounts
message.mod_e539c988.mode_void: Void trolley selected: passes straight through blocks without gravity
message.mod_e539c988.mode_physical: Physical trolley selected: collides with blocks and obeys gravity
comment.mod_e539c988.bioethicist.1: <%1$s> Consequentially speaking, the consequence for %2$s has occurred.
comment.mod_e539c988.bioethicist.2: <%1$s> This proves that standing on tracks carries ethical risk.
comment.mod_e539c988.bioethicist.3: <%1$s> We should form a committee to study why %2$s did not dodge.
comment.mod_e539c988.bioethicist.4: <%1$s> Procedurally, that trolley clearly filed no collision request.
comment.mod_e539c988.bioethicist.5: <%1$s> Stay calm. What happened to %2$s could make an excellent paper.
